5200-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with different powers.
5200-8190.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

112-757-4221-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
112-757-4221-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Clockspinning to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Living Plane, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

3257-5413-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

3259-3480-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-3480-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Purphoros can be omitted.

3179-3641-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-3641-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1167-5529-7692.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Generous Plunderer triggers, creating an artifact token.
Activate Shuri by paying {1} and tapping it, causing the artifact token to become a copy of Mindslaver that isn't legendary.
Activate the artifact token by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

360-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

277-3430-4499-6973.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Mutable Explorer.
When Mutable Explorer enters, it triggers, creating a tapped Mutavault land token.
When the Mutavault token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the Mutavault token.
Activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4565-4762-5902.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

677-4217-5211-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
677-4217-5211-6797.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Lutri.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Lutri from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
677-4217-5211-6797.notes: You can start the combo instead at step 7 if Lutri is in your graveyard. This changes the mana needed to {6}{W}{U}{B}{R}{R}{G}.

2366-5702-7060-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5702-7060-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-1449-6441.description:
Activate Plundering Barbarian by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Barbarian enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Barbarian.
Resolve the Plundering Barbarian trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4446-4681-5170-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-4681-5170-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

57-2341-4846-4885.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon is not your commander.
57-2341-4846-4885.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-2829-4023-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-2829-4023-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

141-4050-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

620-3532-3581-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-3532-3581-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

339-677-3499-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3951-5658.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to create three token copies of Éomer and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Put all Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Éomer tokens trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get three additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1563-1849-2457-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-5033-6517.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-5033-6517.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1069-2438-4766-5222.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender and Sword of the Realms attached to the same nontoken creature you control.
1069-2438-4766-5222.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with Sword of the Realms and Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Sword of the Realms and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {0}, attaching it to the creature that has Deathrender attached.
Repeat.

215-5334-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

273-3156-3621-4763.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, targeting Koll.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2511-3951-4452-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2511-3951-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

645-914-2511-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
645-914-2511-3750.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

2777-4050-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Driver of the Dead in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
2777-4050-5326.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Master, adding one mana of any color.
When The Master dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Repeat.

2450-3152-4445.notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to a legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
2450-3152-4445.description:
Activate the creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {4}{U} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Chakram Retriever.
Chakram Retriever triggers, causing you to untap the creature with Leyline Immersion attached.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Chakram Retriever's ability to untap any other creature(s) you control.

2773-3059-3231.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2034-2523-4112.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sharuum, adding {C}{C}.
Sharuum dies, triggering Ratadrabik, creating a nonlegendary copy of Sharuum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
The Sharuum token enters the battlefield, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning any artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2018-2781-4050-4468.description:
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Phyrexian Altar to add 1 mana of any color.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Felidar Guardian to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Felidar Guardian's ETB triggers, exiling Mystic Decree and then returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1283-1987-2493.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {3}, blinking Archaeomancer and Chromatic Orrery.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.
